evidence_quotes.quote: Using latrine desludging services in Dakar as a case-study, we document that prices are 40% lower in competitive areas than in areas where prices are coordinated by a trade association.

We then develop an experimental just-in-time auction platform with random variation in several design features to formally test for collusive conduct and estimate the welfare costs of imperfect competition.

This would significantly increase take-up of the improved sanitation technology, with back-of-the-envelope calculations suggesting improvements in health of a similar magnitude to those from building improved sewerage systems.

raw_response.plain_vs_narrow_note: Under the active 2026-10-13 narrow rule-type reading of Criterion 2, private bidder collusion, trade-association price coordination, and researcher-designed experimental auction features are private industrial-organization/market-design mechanisms rather than state legal, administrative, regulatory, tenure, public tariff/subsidy, enforcement, or utility-regulatory rules (exclude, E03). Under the literal plain wording of Criterion 2 ('any legal, administrative, institutional, regulatory, or governance factor'), trade-association price coordination and institutional auction rules plausibly constitute institutional or market-governance factors warranting full-text inspection (unsure).
raw_response.rationale: The study empirically examines household sanitation access (latrine desludging prices and counterfactual take-up of improved sanitation technology in Dakar, Senegal; C1=yes, C3=yes, C4=yes). However, under the narrow rule-type reading of Criterion 2, the exposure studied is private-sector imperfect competition/bidder collusion (including informal/private price coordination by a trade association) and researcher-randomized design features in an experimental auction platform, rather than a legal, administrative, regulatory, tenure, public tariff/subsidy, bureaucratic discretion, enforcement/disconnection, or utility-regulatory mechanism (C2_narrow=no; E03 wrong exposure).
